name: fcc-broadband-mcp-server
description: Access FCC broadband availability, coverage analysis, and digital divide data for US geographies and census blocks via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Query FCC broadband availability, coverage analysis, and digital-divide data for US geographies and census blocks via MCP.
interface.longDescription: MCP server for FCC broadband data. Geocode coordinates to census blocks, query reported providers and advertised speeds, and compare geography-level coverage populations using the June 2021 Form 477 filing. Discover newer BDC bulk-file manifests with credentials. Historical population aggregates support gap research but do not establish current address service or funding eligibility. STDIO and Streamable HTTP transports.
